title: Workshop Visits on the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan: Notice, Included Work and What a Visit Consumes
content:
A visit under the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan is booked the plan's lead time ahead, and a booking made at shorter notice is taken where the network has room but carries no turnaround promise.

### The rule

The work a visit may carry is the work the plan includes, at the intervals the plan sets, and an oil change asked for before the plan's mileage interval has run is chargeable work rather than an included service.

A completed visit consumes one included service whatever the work done, so a detail and a brake service each cost one service, and a visit taken with no service left is invoiced in full at the plan's discounted parts and capped labour rates.

A visit may be rescheduled at no charge up to the plan's rescheduling notice in whole elapsed hours before it, and cancelled at no charge up to the plan's cancellation notice; inside either, the plan's missed visit fee applies. A vehicle not brought in at all carries the missed visit fee and consumes no service, since no work was done.

Visits are recorded only while the plan is in the active state, so a paused or lapsed plan books nothing and a visit taken while the plan was paused is invoiced in full.

### What each outcome costs

| What happened to the visit | What follows from it |
| --- | --- |
| Completed, with an included service left on the plan | One included service is consumed, whatever the work done |
| Completed, with no included service left | The visit is invoiced in full, parts at the plan's discount and labour at the plan's ceiling |
| Moved earlier than the plan's rescheduling notice | No charge for the move |
| Moved inside the plan's rescheduling notice | The plan's missed visit fee applies |
| Called off earlier than the plan's cancellation notice | No charge for the cancellation |
| Called off inside the plan's cancellation notice | The plan's missed visit fee applies |
| The vehicle not brought in at all | The plan's missed visit fee applies, and no included service is consumed, no work having been done |
| Taken while the plan stood paused | The visit is invoiced in full |

### The state the plan must stand in

A visit is recorded against a plan standing in the active state, read from the marketplace's own record of that plan and read before the visit is recorded. A plan standing as paused or as lapsed books nothing.

### Points of judgement on included work

Whether a piece of work is an included service or chargeable work turns on the plan's own list of included items and on the intervals the plan sets. An oil change on a plan that includes one, asked for before the plan's mileage interval, being the miles between two included oil changes, has run, is chargeable work; the same change once that interval has run is an included service. The notice figures are counted in whole elapsed hours before the visit was to start.
